riceCounterWest: 先看牌，再过秤。账咱们一袋一袋地算。
Check the board, then the scales. We'll settle up sack by sack.
riceCounterEast: 对岸来的米搁柜台边。我们照牌价算，也能谈谈。
Set the rice from across the river by my counter. We can use the posted price, or talk.
riceWestSeals: 三枚印，你来落。手稳，我就添钱。
Three seals. Set them yourself. A steady hand earns you a better offer.
riceWest: 四袋新米刚上秤。买几袋，你自己往船上搬。
Four sacks of fresh rice, just weighed. Load as many as you fancy.
riceEast: 靠稳了？先解绳，我来接货。
Tied up? Undo the rope. I'll take the sacks.
riceLoaded: 数清啦。每装一袋，仓里就少一袋。
Count them as you load. One on the boat, one less in the shed.
riceEmpty: 货架见底了。下个集日，我得换块价牌。
Bare shelves! I'll have to change my board for the next market.
ricePlenty: 米都堆到门边了，先腾条路出来吧。
Sacks right up to the door. Let's leave a path through.
riceMonth: 月初头一班船。两边掌柜都把新牌挂起来了。
First sailing of the month. Both merchants have put up fresh prices.
riceSeals: 三枚商印。你的手稳，我的钱袋就得松一点。
Three merchant seals. A steady hand might loosen my purse.
riceDeal: 成交！听这钱袋，可比早晨沉多了。
Deal done! That purse sounds heavier already.
riceSign: 匾给你扶住了。挂正点，明天老客才找得着。
I'll hold the sign. Hang it straight so your regulars can find you.
welcome: 铃铛在车把上。轻点拉，上次半条街的人都来了！
The bell’s on the handle. Gently! I called half the street last time.
quayChat: 听见了吗？是缆绳在敲木桩。
Hear that? It's the mooring line knocking on the post.
millChat: 你把手伸过来，摸摸这粉磨得有多细。
Give me your hand. Feel how fine that flour is.
ovenChat: 这炉子有年头了。闭着眼我都知道它的脾气。
I've worked this old oven for years. I know its moods with my eyes shut.
streetChat: 你听，我站这儿就知道哪家开门了。
Listen. From right here I can tell which shop just opened.
customer: 听见啦。给我一个刚出炉的！
I heard you! One fresh loaf, please.
arrival: 听！这条船都停航三年了。谁把它开回来了？
Listen! That ferry hasn't run in three years. Who brought it back?
dock: 帮我递到甲板上。舱里还有人等着呢。
Pass them up onto the deck. There's a hungry crew below.
workers: 我来接。里头的人从天亮就没歇过。
Here, I'll take them. The crew hasn't stopped since dawn.
flour: 拿稳，袋子沉。新磨的粉烤出来香。
Steady now, it's heavy. Freshly milled flour makes a lovely loaf.
bake: 你管炉门，我来接盘。闻到香味了吗？
You mind the oven door. I'll catch the tray. Smell that?
clue: 那盏灯是修桥队挂的。他们终于回家了。
The bridge crew hung that lamp. They're finally home.
dawn: 开门啦。你瞧，昨天的人又来了。
Time to open up. Look who's back from yesterday.
sail: 跳上来！对岸这会儿刚开集。
Hop aboard! The market across the water is just opening.
fire: 这炉子烧得旺。第一盘，归你。
She's a good hot oven. The first tray's yours.
